capabilities: Visualize the current note or folder's headings as an interactive mind map
Rewrite structural edits (rename, reparent, delete, copy/paste) back to the .md file
Render external links, wiki links and linked mentions as edges
Share individual notes with a BloomMD workspace for opt-in collaboration
Review, approve, reject or undo AI agent change proposals in an agent panel
extras: The README warns that the plugin writes to the note being viewed and recommends trying it on a copy first; it adds one HTML comment per heading for stable node IDs. Distribution is beta-only via BRAT or manual release files, and the wider BloomMD desktop/web app is in a separate closed beta. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see and restructure a note's heading hierarchy as a visual map while keeping the Markdown file as the source of truth.

relations.evidence: Install the Obsidian42 - BRAT community plugin.
If an AI agent such as OpenClaw files notes into this vault through bloommd-wiki agent mcp

summary: Mind-map editor that turns a note's or folder's heading structure into an interactive node map and writes structural edits back to the Markdown files.
